name: stateflow-apply-layout
description: Use when a Stateflow diagram needs arranging — after adding states, transitions, or junctions through the Stateflow API has left elements overlapping, or when someone opens an existing chart, subchart state, box or function, atomic subchart, or atomic box and wants a messy diagram cleaned up, organized, reorganized, or tidied with no edit involved. Also use when a user names applySFAutolayout directly.
